d: An unhappy woman tries to change her future when she travels back in time to her senior year of high school.
A spoiled socialite is marooned on a deserted island with a sailor who cannot stand her.
A woman  heads to L.A. to become a TV star  her nephew back in Alabama witnesses a racially motivated murder.
A federal agent is assigned to spy on his mother and her new lover, both suspects in an art theft ring.
